categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Robots.txt reachable and compliant with RFC 9309
Deliberate AI crawler controls: OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot allowed; GPTBot model training blocked
Soft-404 hygiene validated with real HTTP 404 responses
Cloudflare CDN edge-cached with HTTP/3 and compression enabled
Clean static breadcrumb navigation and regional clustering pre-rendered at build time

findings.title: Noindexed URLs published in sitemap.xml
findings.description: 13 multilingual subpages under /apps/what-should-i-eat-*/ carry 'robots: noindex, follow' meta tags but remain listed in sitemap.xml. Submitting noindexed URLs creates conflicting indexing directives.
findings.recommendation: Filter out pages with robots 'noindex' from sitemap.njk template.

findings.title: IndexNow ping automation not active
findings.description: The site has an indexNow.txt key in the workspace but lacks an automated post-deploy API trigger to push URL updates instantly to Bing and IndexNow-compatible engines.
findings.recommendation: Integrate indexnow_submit.py into the deployment workflow.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Zero AI prompt tokens or fake (Premium Users) markers remaining across apps
Cornerstone agile guides provide 2,500+ words of actionable team ritual advice
High information density (0.46) on main directory and tool landing pages

findings.title: Doorway page risk on programmatic city food wheels
findings.description: 20+ city dining pages share near-identical structural boilerplate with only the city name replaced. Under Google Quality Rater Guidelines §4.6.5 (Scaled Content Abuse) and doorway algorithms, this limits long-term indexation.
findings.recommendation: Inject unique regional culinary data, distinct local neighborhoods, and signature regional dishes into each city data set.

findings.title: Missing author credentials and first-hand E-E-A-T proof
findings.description: Cornerstone blog guides lack personal author bylines, professional practitioner bios, and first-hand photographic evidence of tools used in actual agile ceremonies.
findings.recommendation: Introduce verified author profile cards with Scrum Master / Agile Coach credentials and real workshop screenshots.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid WebApplication schema across all 112 app pages with Free offer pricing
Valid BreadcrumbList schema accurately reflecting hierarchical site structure

findings.title: FAQPage rich results retired by Google
findings.description: Google completely retired FAQPage rich snippets for all sites on May 7, 2026. Over 110 pages on Daily Pick have FAQPage blocks intended to capture SERP real estate. They provide no rich result benefit.
findings.recommendation: Maintain existing blocks for internal semantics, but avoid investing effort in writing new FAQPage markup for Google SERP visibility. Pivot single-topic Q&A to QAPage where applicable.

findings.title: Blog author schema configured as Organization instead of Person
findings.description: _includes/post.njk outputs author as '@type': 'Organization'. Google's Helpful Content system prefers individual Person entities with verifiable credentials.
findings.recommendation: Update author schema to @type Person with jobTitle and sameAs links.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness & Agentic Browsing
what_works: llms.txt and llms-full.txt present, properly formatted, and passing Lighthouse ARD checks
Agent-UX score of 92/100 with 100+ native interactive accessible nodes
Server-rendered HTML serves 1,200+ words of content prior to JS execution
Robots.txt deliberately permits OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Claude-SearchBot

findings.title: Two form inputs missing explicit label associates
findings.description: agent_ux_check.py detected 2 inputs lacking explicit label[for] attributes, deducting 8 points from the Agent-UX readiness score.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all input elements have matching label tags or aria-label attributes.

findings.title: Missing Markdown content negotiation
findings.description: The site does not support HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) or .md alternative URLs for LLM scraping agents.
findings.recommendation: Configure Cloudflare Worker to serve clean Markdown representation when Accept: text/markdown is requested.

categories.name: Search Experience Optimization (SXO)
what_works: 100% free, zero ads experience strongly outperforms ad-laden competitors (Wheel Decide, Picker Wheel)
Instant canvas interaction without login or paywalls
Shareable query state (?choices=...) enables collaborative viral loops

findings.title: Missing one-click Slack/Teams meeting notes export
findings.description: Teams using Daily Pick in standups need an instant button to copy formatted results directly to clipboard for Slack, Discord, or Jira sprint notes.
findings.recommendation: Add a prominent '📋 Copy for Slack / Teams' button on spin completion.

findings.title: Dedicated /compare/ landing hubs not yet live
findings.description: Comparison content currently lives as blog posts rather than conversion-focused pillar landing pages.
